text:
Predicates:
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Premieres(z, y) ::: z premiered y.
Orchestra(z) ::: z is an orchestra.
Leads(x, z) ::: x leads z.
Conducts(z) ::: z is a conductor.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Premise:
MusicPiece(symphony9) ∧ Composer(beethoven) ∧ Wrote(beethoven, symphony9) ∧ Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ∧ Premieres(viennaMusicSociety, symphony9) ∧ Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ∧ Orchestra(z) → Conducts(z) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
